title: Correct wavelength ratio
description: Essential: The student must state the ratio λ_left/λ_right = 1/2.

title: Velocity ratio reasoning
description: Important: The student should relate wave velocities to distances OA and OB using equal travel times.

title: Correct period formula
description: Essential: The student must derive or state T = 2Δt/(2n+1) with n as a non-negative integer.

title: Phase condition application
description: Important: The student must apply the opposite-vibration condition to establish the half-wavelength path difference condition Δx = (2n+1)λ/2.

title: Path difference expression
description: Important: The student should correctly express the path difference between A and B as Δx = vΔt.

title: Integer parameter inclusion
description: Optional: The student explicitly states that n = 0, 1, 2, ... in the period formula.

title: Sign or integer error
description: Pitfall: Using even integer (2n) instead of odd integer (2n+1) in the half-wavelength condition.

title: Ratio inversion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly inverting the wavelength or velocity ratio (e.g., stating 2 instead of 1/2).
